name: Sakai Knife (Petty Knife)
about: A petty knife made in Sakai, Osaka, a city known for its blacksmiths for over 400 years. Sakai's knives are prized by Japanese chefs for their sharp, long-lasting edges.
tip: Pack it in checked luggage only. Knives cannot be carried in your hand luggage on flights.

name: Pewter Sake Cup
about: A small sake cup made of pewter, a traditional Osaka craft. Suzuki is a well-known local maker of this metalwork.
tip: Buy it at the Shinsaibashi shop listed here, since it is one of the places that sells this craft.

name: Takoyaki Sauce
about: A thick, sweet and tangy sauce for takoyaki, the octopus balls that Osaka is famous for. Locals use it on many street foods.
tip: Check with the seller before you buy, since the notes give no extra details.
